title: selinum wallichianum var. elatum
intro: Selinum wallichianum var. elatum, commonly known as Wild Celery, is a plant species belonging to the parsley family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Celery include expectorant, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, which can help relieve congestion, soothe muscle spasms, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Wild Celery include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
